subject: Universe is taking a little detour through Paris
body:
One day of GitHub Universe, closer to home. 30 November, Comet Bourse, 35 Rue Saint-Marc. <[[https://github.com]]> Universe on the Road Paris Register now Universe on the Road comes to Paris on 30 November. We're bringing the strongest conversations from GitHub Universe into a smaller local setting: how AI and agents are changing software delivery, what leaders should prepare for now, and how to turn experimentation into progress across real teams. You'll hear directly from GitHub, customers and peers, with enough space for a proper conversation. Here's a sneak peek of what the day will look like: - Get an inside look at the GitHub product roadmap and what's next - Hear what other organizations are achieving with GitHub - Choose a curated track of breakout sessions relevant to your organization's goals - Celebrate innovation through Ship & Tell sessions showcasing projects built in a day - Connect with other leaders and your local developer community Monday 30 November 2026 09:00 to 17:00 Comet Bourse, 35 Rue Saint-Marc, 75002 Paris Seats are limited, and we'll confirm your place by email.
